data.title: Binghatti Gardenia
data.about:
Binghatti Gardenia stands as a testament to a harmonious balance between aesthetic allure and functional design, offering  residents a choice to Select from studios, 1 to 3 bedroom apartments. 

The project is characterized by its symbolic design elements, where individual balconies interweave to sculpt a unified, vibrant community. This innovative design approach not only provides residents with outdoor spaces for enjoyment and relaxation but also contributes to the building’s sustainability by offering shade, thereby minimizing energy consumption for cooling the living spaces. 

Infused with Binghatti Developers’ signature contemporary design ethos, whilst paying homage to the rich traditional elements inherent in Middle Eastern art and architecture, Binghatti Gardenia presents a blend of modernity and heritage. The unique balcony design prioritizes residents’ privacy, allowing them to relish the outdoor space without compromise. Nestled in a prime location, Binghatti Gardenia promises not only a luxurious living experience but also a fruitful investment for its future owners.

location_tile.title: The best location in JVC
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti Gardenia's enviable spot in Jumeirah Village Circle opens up a world of community-centric perks, essentials, and facilities. Those calling it home have easy access to educational institutions, healthcare centers, and select grocery stores, all anchored by the nearby Circle Mall. The area's diverse dining options, coffee houses, and upscale hotels invite residents to mingle and fully immerse themselves in an urban ambiance.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 03 Minutes to Remraam Community Park
  • 04 Minutes to Circle Mall
  • 16 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
  • 19 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 24 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
